```python
def rename_tag(self, old: str, new: str) -> int:
    """Renames one tag on every note that has it. Returns how many notes changed."""
    target = normalize_tag(old)
    replacement = normalize_tag(new)
    changed = 0
    for note in self.notes.values():
        if target not in note["tags"]:
            continue
        note["tags"] = sorted({replacement if tag == target else tag for tag in note["tags"]})
        changed += 1
    if changed:
        self.save()
    return changed
```

```python
def update(self, note_id: str, title: Optional[str] = None, body: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
    note = self.notes.get(note_id)
    if note is None:
        return False
    if title is not None:
        note["title"] = title
    if body is not None:
        note["body"] = body
    self.save()
    return True
```
